property: The core produces a complete, verifiable agent handoff without depending on any renderer's contract.

input.notes: Synthetic profile, assets and analysis with fixed timestamps. No provider call, no committed binary fixture, no real brand material.

assertions.statement: The core reaches a ready-for-execution brief without a renderer.
The exported inventory is complete, self-verified and declares its mode and entrypoint.
Every generated byte matches the committed public example, and only README.md is authored by hand.
Exporting the same case twice produces the same inventory.
No OpenDesign manifest, slot file or catalog reference reaches the core output.
The handoff declares agent-handoff/v1 and a named entrypoint.
